title: ServerManager
description: Quick control and gameplay settings. Easily toggle PvP and PvE in the Overworld, Nether, and End, and use player freezing tools to temporarily lock players in place.
body:
# ServerManager

ServerManager is a powerful yet easy-to-use administration plugin for **Paper Minecraft servers**. It gives server owners full control over combat, environment settings, permissions-based access, and moderation tools.

---

## Features

### Dimension Control
- Toggle access to dimensions:
  - Nether
  - End

### Moderation Tools
- Built-in **player freeze system**
  - Temporarily immobilize players for moderation
  - Useful for investigations, rule enforcement, and suspicious activity checks
- Toggle **Player Vs Player**
  - Useful for investigations and rule enforcement

### Main Command Interface
- Central command: **`/manager`** opens GUI
- Quick access to:
  - PvP/PvE toggles
  - Freeze/unfreeze tools
  - Enable dimesion access
  - Configuration settings (permission-based)

---

## Design Goals

- Performance-focused
- Reliable and stable
- Flexible server customization
- Simple staff workflow
